task.title: Register Phase L (Local AI and Intelligent Automation) as dependency-ordered Beads work items
task.objective: File one Phase L epic and its ten milestone children (L0, L1, L2, L3, L4a, L4b, L5a, L5b, L6, L7) from docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/ROADMAP.md, with parent-child links and blocks edges that encode the plan's milestone order, then refresh .beads/issues.jsonl with bd export -o. The lease exists only because bd writes require the project-state role; the phase-model registration in src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts, the dashboard parser/verifier pins and the docs/ai narrative updates are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits made after this lease is released. No milestone is started, claimed or closed.

acceptance.description: One Phase L epic and exactly ten milestone children exist in the tracker, each child linked to the epic by parent-child, with blocks edges L0 before L1, L2, L4a and L5a; L1 and L2 before L3; L1 and L4a before L4b; L1 and L5a before L5b; L2 and L4b before L6; and L3, L4b, L5b and L6 before L7. Only the epic and L0 are ready.

.beads/issues.jsonl is refreshed with bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl so the Program Status dashboard parses the new items, and verify:roadmap-dashboard passes with the Overview banner reading Sources agree after its pins move deliberately.

evidence.command: bd show awkit-djnl, bd show awkit-djnl.2, bd show awkit-djnl.3 and the output of each bd dep add
evidence.observed: bd show awkit-djnl lists exactly ten children (awkit-djnl.1 to .10). The mapping is L0 .2, L1 .1, L2 .3, L3 .4, L4a .5, L4b .6, L5a .7, L5b .8, L6 .9, L7 .10: the first L1 was created with --deps blocks:awkit-djnl.1, which in this bd version records that the NEW issue blocks the named one, so bd show awkit-djnl.2 listed awkit-djnl.1 under BLOCKS. Instead of leaving a junk issue, the two titles, descriptions, acceptance, priorities and spec links were exchanged with bd update, which turns that edge into the intended L0-before-L1. The direction of bd dep add was then proven without side effects: bd dep add awkit-djnl.1 awkit-djnl --type parent-child was refused as a duplicate of the existing child link, so bd dep add A B records A depends on B. Each of the remaining 15 bd dep add calls printed 'X depends on Y (blocks)' with the intended prerequisite, and bd show awkit-djnl.3 lists awkit-djnl.2 under DEPENDS ON.
Ready: 2 issues with no active blockers - awkit-djnl.2 (L0) and the epic awkit-djnl. Every other milestone is dependency-blocked (bd stats Blocked 9).

Printed 'Exported 302 issues to .beads/issues.jsonl'. bd stats then reported Total 302, Open 11, In Progress 0, dependency-Blocked 9, Closed 289, Ready 2. The verifier's independent recount of issue records in the export text matched the parse (302).

A measuring run before the pins moved failed exactly the three tracker pins (got 302 issues, 13 outstanding / 289 closed, 134 edges) and passed the new phase checks. After the pins were moved to those measured values, the final-state run printed '177/177 roadmap dashboard checks passed', including '12 phases', 'phase ids are exactly A..L', 'no cycles in the real data', 'every declared-blocked issue is present and out of the layers' (still the two Oracle items) and 'the Overview banner reads "Sources agree"'. npm run build also passed on the final state.

completion.qa_basis: Tracker structure, ready set and export were inspected with bd show, bd ready and bd stats after every write, and the final state passed npm run build and verify:roadmap-dashboard 177/177 with Sources agree.
completion.qa_known_limitations: Two direct-loop edits sit outside this contract's project-state routing by design and are disclosed rather than hidden: src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts (phase L added, id union widened) and scripts/verify-roadmap-dashboard.mjs (phase and tracker pins moved to measured values). Both were made unleased after the lease was released, as CLAUDE.md permits for ordinary non-Risk-3 work. node tools/agents/task-gate.mjs therefore reports canComplete false with 5 derived scope escapes, all traceable to those two files (the qa and software ownership domains, the implied general_engineering_change flag, and the two paths), which is why completion.status is implemented rather than complete. L0 and L1 carry swapped dotted numbers (see beads-structure). The in-app Roadmap page and the Program Status dashboard were not inspected in a GUI; the page maps over the phase list with no count assumption and the dashboard API served the new snapshot inside the verifier.

history.released_reason: Phase L epic awkit-djnl and ten ordered milestones filed with parent-child and blocks edges, export refreshed to 302 issues
